name: Người tiền sử tóc bù áo da thú

identity.head: round white, bold dark ink (near-black) outline, no ears
identity.hair: messy dark-brown hair tuft standing up on top of the head, short uneven doodle strokes
identity.mouth: simple line, expression changes per scene (curious/worried/smiling)
identity.outfit: single-tone earthy brown fur/hide tunic, one shoulder wrap, roughly cut hem
identity.accent: necklace of small bone/tooth beads around the neck — the one distinctive, repeatable accessory
identity.limbs: dark ink stick arms and legs, simple rounded hands and feet, may hold a wooden stick/spear as a prop

distinguishing_notes: Deliberately different from both the vocab channel mascot (assets/characters/channel-mascot: light-blue T-shirt, no hair) and from the Ink Explainer channel's own stick figure: this character has visible messy hair, an earth-tone fur tunic (not a modern shirt) and a bone-necklace accent unique to this channel. Original design, not a copy of any existing channel's character.
usage: Always attach the reference image as character reference once generated; text description alone is insufficient. Preserve identity (head/hair/outfit/necklace) across scenes. Use a separate base-scene reference for scene continuity. Used as CH01 in every tiensu channel script.
generation: Not yet generated. This is a text-only character definition (GĐ1 scaffolding); no image has been produced and no Flow/image-generation call has been made for this character.
